name: Principles Relating to Processing of Personal Data
description: Personal data shall be processed lawfully, fairly, transparently, accurately, securely, and only for specified purposes.

name: Responsibility of the Controller
description: Controllers shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure GDPR compliance.

name: Data Protection by Design and by Default
description: Data protection measures shall be integrated into systems and processes by design and by default.

name: Records of Processing Activities
description: Controllers and processors shall maintain records of processing activities under their responsibility.

name: Security of Processing
description: Controllers and processors shall implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure a level of security appropriate to the risk.

name: Notification of a Personal Data Breach to the Supervisory Authority
description: In the event of a personal data breach, the controller shall notify the competent supervisory authority without undue delay and, where feasible, within 72 hours after becoming aware of it, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons.

name: Communication of a Personal Data Breach to the Data Subject
description: When a personal data breach is likely to result in a high risk to the rights and freedoms of natural persons, the controller shall communicate the breach to the affected data subjects without undue delay.

name: Governance
description: Management bodies shall approve, oversee and be accountable for cybersecurity risk-management measures.

name: Cybersecurity Risk-Management Measures
description: Implement appropriate and proportionate technical, operational, and organisational measures to manage cybersecurity risks and minimise the impact of incidents.

name: Reporting Obligations
description: Essential and important entities shall notify significant cybersecurity incidents within the required timelines.

name: Use of European Cybersecurity Certification Schemes
description: Member States shall encourage the use of European cybersecurity certification schemes where appropriate.

name: Standardisation
description: Member States shall encourage the use of European and international cybersecurity standards to improve security and interoperability.

name: Supervisory and Enforcement Measures
description: Competent authorities shall supervise compliance and enforce the requirements of the Directive.

name: Administrative Fines
description: Member States shall establish effective, proportionate and dissuasive administrative fines for non-compliance with the Directive.
